Here is a curated playlist for your warm summer afternoon backyard barbecue, blending upbeat country and reggae tracks to keep the vibe laid-back and social:

1. "Three Little Pigs" – Jason Aldean (Upbeat country energy)
2. "Island in the Sun" – Weezer (Reggae-infused chill)
3. "Chicken Fried" – Zac Brown Band (Perfect BBQ anthem)
4. "Three Little Birds" – Bob Marley & The Wailers (Classic relaxation)
5. "Body Like a Back Road" – Sam Hunt (Modern country groove)
6. "No Woman, No Cry" – Bob Marley & The Wailers (Smooth, nostalgic vibe)
7. "Wagon Wheel" – Darius Rucker (Sing-along favorite)
8. "Jamming" – Bob Marley & The Wailers (Feel-good rhythm)
9. "Tennessee Whiskey" – Chris Stapleton (Soulful country chill)
10. "Could You Be Loved" – Bob Marley & The Wailers (Upbeat closer)

Enjoy your barbecue and the company of your guests!
